A private, data-only store of a project's acquired wisdom, read and
written by [agent sessions](agent-session.md). The established kinds:
[decision-memory](decision-memory.md) (rulings),
[session-memory](session-memory.md) (what happened),
[evidence-memory](evidence-memory.md) (detections). Append-only,
and memory, never a backlog — work is tracked on the forge.
